title: Party Role Context Contract

risks.desc: A tenant, channel or app mismatch could bind a party role across isolation boundaries.
risks.mitigation: Require exact tenant context, temporal validity and negative Tenant A/B fixtures with fail-closed rejection.

risks.desc: Party identity or audit fields could be retained beyond KVKK purpose and retention limits.
risks.mitigation: Bind data classification, retention owner, deletion or anonymization path, legal hold and redacted audit plan.

risks.desc: Role context planning could be misread as credential, authentication/SSO or PDP policy ownership.
risks.mitigation: Keep exclusions explicit and block AI RoleBinding activation until human approval is recorded.

rollback: Withdraw only party-role-context-contract, set its D01 row back to pending, remove its app/kernel registry and generated projections, regenerate the exact 621-node 33/4/29 NO-GO state, and leave runtime data unchanged.
